seal.statement: Every pattern in the epic budget is held by a one-way ratchet: scripts/check-guideline-navigability.js reads the shared detector module, records a per-violation baseline JSON per pattern in the guideline-check-shared.js shape with --update-baseline and the tighten hint, is chained into npm run audit:guidelines and so into test:static and the pre-push gate, and docs/development/code-style.md names each pattern together with the form that replaces it; the budget row navigability_patterns_without_ratchet reads zero. The audit covers the fallback family too (two-source reads, typeof dual paths, catch-and-default, alias exports, legacy vocabulary), each with its own baseline file.
